criteria: Judge whether the close record's completion-predicate verdicts are supported by the phase records it cites (002 to 008 in the same directory); cite the record line for any verdict you dispute.
Check that every open-question row in records 002 to 008 has exactly one disposition in the close record's sweep, and that each 'fixed' or 'discharged' claim is supported by the cited record.
Check that the plan's close repairs, tagged (c), only record what happened and change no approved criterion's intent; flag any that does.
Check that the close plan's Part A to E commitments are met or honestly marked pending in the close record.
Flag any claim in the close record that overstates evidence, such as reproducibility, learner quality or acceptance.
Cite one concrete artifact location for every concern, and mark each concern blocking or non-blocking for closing the milestone.
rubric.name: ilp-learners milestone close review
